<!-- pr-reviewer: eb2404ba188536b802671fce2abec8d534b71ae4 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge**

**What looks good**
- The radius rule is narrow (`crates/app/src/machine/mod.rs`, `spindle_arc`): lathe kind only, `a.plane.is_xy()`, and arc centre within 1e-6 of the WCS origin in both X and Y. Only the X axis (k == 0) is judged by `hypot(x, y)`. Off-axis arcs, arcs in other planes, and straight moves keep signed X, so a real past-centre move is still refused by name ("... in X").
- No unwrap/expect/panic added; the arc test uses `is_some_and`, so there is no indexing or cast risk.
- Pinned by `lathe_thread_travel` (the thread passes `lathe.mch`; the same thread against X 0..2 is still refused). Decision record is in `docs/decisions/`, the body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #631`, and there is no CHANGELOG edit and no new dependency.

**Local results (merged with current upstream/main, clean merge)**
| Suite | Passed |
|---|---|
| lathe_thread_travel | 2 |
| lathe_stroke | 5 |
| machine | 32 |
| machine_library | 11 |
| machine_edit | 12 |
| turning_thread | 8 |
| lathe_post | 7 |
| lathe_post_g76 | 5 |
| lathe_post_refusals | 5 |
| lathe_spindle_law / fit / keyed | 8 / 3 / 6 |
| lathe_cross_drill | 5 |
| tormach_machines | 5 |

`cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. The tests prove the "still refused" case only by shrinking the X stroke. A pinning test for an off-axis XY arc, or a lathe arc in XZ/YZ reaching X<0, that stays refused would lock the "radius only for spindle-axis arcs" boundary the Prime Directive depends on.
2. The 1e-6 tolerance is absolute (mm); fine for now, just noting it is not scaled to units.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
